notes:
Summary: AzulByte is an adtech personalization platform serving real-time creative and ranking decisions into client DSPs. Extremely latency-sensitive: client-facing p95 targets often <25-30ms. High call volumes during campaign spikes (3k-8k RPS typical, bursts to 20k). Cost-sensitive — want to reduce token/unit cost while preserving ranking quality. Interested in Redwood Optimize and Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC peering.

Specific requirements / asks: 
- Workloads: reranking and real-time personalization (light context, ~32-128 tokens typical), embeddings for offline similarity, chat assistant for ops.
- Latency: p95 end-to-end target <30ms for main rerank endpoint; cold-start tail acceptable up to 200ms for noncritical flows.
- Throughput: steady 5k RPS target for POC; need autoscale/burst to 20k with graceful degradation.
- Cost: aggressive unit-cost goals; want cost comparison across int8 vs int4 quantized variants and batching profiles.
- Models: prefer compact chat models (mix of open models, 7-13B quantized), fallback to larger model only for outliers.
- Batching: want dynamic batching up to batch_size=16 for throughput windows, but strict per-request latencySLOs.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for repeated user prefixes; TTLs on cache ~30s-5m depending on campaign. Evaluate effect on p95 and cost.
- Quantization: run int8 baseline, int4 experimental; need QC on hallucination/regression risk.
- Benchmarking asks: deliver a matrix of perf results across {seq_len:32,128,512} x {batch:1,4,8,16} x {quant:fp16,int8,int4} with p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput RPS, and cost-per-1k-invocations.

Client quotes / call notes: 
- "If p95 creeps above 30ms we lose placement contracts" — Head of Engineering (A. Malik).
- "We can tolerate slightly lower quality if cost savings are material, but need metrics" — Product lead.

POC plan (agreed):
- Redwood to run controlled bench: 3 model sizes (7B quant int8, 13B int8, 13B int4 experimental) on Dedicated pool + hosted baseline.
- Measure sequence lengths {32,128,512}, batch sizes {1,4,8,16}. Capture p50/p95/p99, RPS, token cost.
- Run caching ablation: with/without prefix caching and with TTL=30s/300s.
- Produce recommendation: batching strategy, cache policy, quantization profile, expected monthly cost at target 5k RPS.

Open items / blockers: 
- VPC peering requires infra security sign-off (ticket SEC-1107).
- Legal needs DPA and contract redlines (in progress).
- Data residency: several EU clients require EU-only residency for embeddings storage.
- Need to schedule 2-day benchmark window (requested week of 2026-04-20).

Artifacts referenced: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ link, Fireflies meeting ids above, Jira tickets INF-3421 (perf measurement) and SEC-1107 (VPC).

Short-term next steps: schedule benchmark window, share required test harness (AzulByte will provide load generator), exchange KMS and SSO SAML metadata for eval environment.
